justification: Both surfaces show the identical composition: three arched forms over a triangle-fringed band, a left-facing open-jawed quadruped with a small crouching figure beneath it and a splayed reptilian creature to the right, and below the shaft a long-necked bird beside a ribbed, radiating-line creature, all in the same low-relief outline convention on the same stepped panel shape. The only differences are of preservation, angle and surface finish, which are not iconographic; this is effectively the same scene.
